input.quote: Such inspections may be made no more than once each calendar year, at reasonable times and upon reasonable notice. Commerce One shall bear all costs and expenses of such inspection. If any such inspection discloses a shortfall or an overpayment, the appropriate party shall promptly pay the amount of such shortfall or refund such overpayment.
input.rationale: The audit right is limited to once per calendar year, conducted by an independent certified public accountant reasonably acceptable to us, at Commerce One's cost unless underpayment exceeds 5%, and gives no access to our systems — this meets our preferred position. Only the notice period is expressed as "reasonable notice" rather than a fixed 30/15 days, which we note rather than flag.
